extraction_notes: Digitised plotted performance data from SI Figures S9a, S9b and S15a shown in the supplied SI page images. Equilibrium curves and the Arrhenius plot in SI Figure S15b were skipped. SI pages S7/S8 mentioned in the captions were not supplied as images here, so stability/time-on-stream plots were not digitised.
